findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_buildings, get_building_report, get_landlord_record, get_neighborhood_stats, get_review_summary · Private data: search_buildings, get_building_report, get_landlord_record · Public sink: get_building_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_buildings, get_building_report, get_landlord_record, get_neighborhood_stats, get_review_summary · Private data: search_buildings, get_building_report, get_landlord_record · Public sink: get_building_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
